blockers: Linux guest has no Node runtime: the guest only provides /usr/bin/python3, so tests/compatibility/linux-runner.test.ts cannot be executed on Linux and the product code under packages/runner-local/src/linux/ has never run there.

The plan's isolation assertions are therefore unexecuted: detachedDescendant.aliveAfterCancel=false, unrelatedProcess.aliveAfterCancel=true and provenance.cleanup=VERIFIED were only reached through their refusal branch on win32, where no process is started at all.

Host preparation needs an unprivileged Node 24.11.1 inside the WSL2 guest plus a systemd user scope (systemd-run --user --scope). A plain wsl -e bash session sits in root-owned /init.scope and is correctly reported as MIGRATION_REFUSED, so it cannot exercise the DELEGATED branch.
Privilege escalation is not a fix and was not used: wsl -u root, sudo, docker run --privileged and pulling a node image are each rejected in docs/compatibility/linux.md section 8.
tasks.next_action: Install an unprivileged Node 24.11.1 in the WSL2 guest and run tests/compatibility/linux-runner.test.ts through systemd-run --user --scope; until the DELEGATED branch really executes, the Linux attribution, cancel and reclaim claims stay unverified.
